hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve token launch hook for pmav.fun V2 (Quoted variant). Implements a virtual AMM curve with 1% fees, block+1 anti-snipe delay, decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, 2% first-hour buy cap with auto-refund, and automatic in-place graduation to a standard Uniswap V4 pool when the raise target is reached. Quote currency is an ERC20 (e.g. USDG) rather than native ETH.
